SEARCH

Class FleetManagement

java.lang.Object
FleetManagement
public class FleetManagement extends Object
Fleet Management System of the Coconut Grove Sailing Club: tracks what the boats of the club cost to buy and to maintain. The fleet is loaded from a CSV file whose name is given on the command line (initialising run) or, when there is no command line parameter, from the file FleetData.db in which the fleet was saved at the end of the previous run. A menu then lets the user print the fleet, add a boat, remove a boat and request permission to spend money on a boat, subject to the Commodore's policy. This class does all the keyboard input and all the file handling of the program.
Author:
Maxime Manuel Afonso

      private static Fleet loadFleetFromDbFile(String dbFileName) throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException

    • createBoat

      private static Boat createBoat(String csvData)
      Creates a boat from one line of CSV data: the type, name, year of manufacture, make/model, length in feet and purchase price of the boat, separated by commas.
      Parameters:
      csvData - the data of the boat, e.g. SAILING,Finesse,1974,Tartan,34,9200.50
      Returns:
      the boat described by the data, with no expenses yet
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the data does not have six fields, or if the type or one of the numbers is not valid
